name: Retrace: Interlude in Jade and Gold
source:
Something strange and magical happened earlier, but that's not important. What's important right now is that your crush is in your room, and he wants to talk. Stay calm, and find your golden ending!

Set after the events of [url=https://spiderlilystudios.itch.io/retrace]Retrace[/url].

[From [url=https://spiderlilystudios.itch.io/retrace-iijag]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
先前发生了些奇怪而神奇的事情，不过那不重要。眼下重要的是，你暗恋的人就在你房间里，而且他想和你谈谈。保持冷静，找到属于你的完美结局吧！

故事发生在[url=https://spiderlilystudios.itch.io/retrace]《Retrace》[/url]剧情结束之后。

[摘自[url=https://spiderlilystudios.itch.io/retrace-iijag]itch.io[/url]]
